judging_guidance: This is a held-out transfer case. Freeze the targeted lesson and candidate before solver access; do not tune on this rubric. criteria.description: Reconstructs visitor-visible catalog consistency, image-caption linkage, unattended recovery and complete publication deadline as the whole outcome.
Compares complete in-place and generation configurations using actual exposure/commit/recovery mechanisms, rather than choosing by record-write speed.
Investigates the supplied durability/reader contract, identifies flush/reopen uncertainty and keeps source guarantees distinct from executed target proof.
Makes a provisional decision and prioritizes a target-representative interrupted complete update, with an observable old-or-new recovery condition and honest current limits.

critical_failures.description: Accepts the in-place entry microbenchmark as proof of complete crash-consistent image-and-caption publication.
Claims that rename alone guarantees the documented power-loss recovery contract or invents target recovery measurements.
